frame.origin: centre of the reproduced district, tunnel floor plane
frame.z: +z up from the TUNNEL FLOOR; the readme's rule is ground = z - 10 m (the STL's terrain under the points is at z = 5 m)
frame.wind_direction_rotation: compass FROM-direction (N = 0, E = 90), so N blows toward -y; flow_dir = (-sin WD, -cos WD). Not stated by the sources; supported by the reference-building choice and by upwind roughness, and at NNW by a solved field (status 'corroborated by a solved field'; the other directions stay 'unverified').

files.format: ASCII STL, LF line endings, outward normals
files.source: BD_caseF.stl (terrain + buildings, November 1978) scaled x800 from model to full-scale metres; 21537 of 21575 horizontal facets faced down as published, so every triangle is reversed to point outward; one shell, open along the rim of the 725 m disc
files.render_caption: Shinjuku sub-centre, November 1978: terrain and buildings of the 1:800 model over a disc of 725 m radius (full-scale metres); north is +y, the towers over 100 m are blue.
